# We believe in

# the power of dialogue

# and empathy

# to bridge divides.
### We engage with people from all walks of life by inviting them to share their real-life experiences. We empower them to make their voices heard in policy-making across Europe.

In a time of growing polarization and division, we stand committed to fostering understanding and unity across Europe. Polarising topics like migration or green transformation ignite heated debates. The complex problems we face require more than populist solutions. We want to ensure that as many voices as possible are heard to discover blindspots and possible ways forward.
## **Each policy maker in the EU parliament should be able to hear your voice!**

Instead of dismissing or protesting against differing views, we’re taking a different path. We step onto the streets, engaging with people from all walks of life, and invite them to share their stories. We provide not only a platform for these voices but also the opportunity for their experiences to shape politics across Europe.

We believe that dialogue and empathy are key to bridging divides. We’re not here to cancel or ignore concerns. Instead, we amplify voices. By truly listening to the stories and perspectives of our fellow citizens, we seek to understand and connect through shared experiences.

Our ultimate goal is to find common solutions that benefit all – from local communities to the broader European landscape. We recognize the complexity of the challenges we face, but we are committed to facing them head-on, in partnership with everyone who calls Europe home.
